comment: Debian alsa-utils for tests/test_x64_capture.py only: usr/bin/aplay is installed as /bin/arecord (aplay records when invoked as arecord) with its copyright file on the private test disk. GPL-2+ userland test tool; nothing from it goes into the kernel or the tree. Verification chain: https://deb.debian.org/debian/dists/trixie/InRelease lists the SHA-256 of main/binary-amd64/Packages.xz (the index below, also tools/chrome-packages/debian-Packages.xz), which lists the package size and SHA-256. aplay needs only libasound.so.2 (1.2.14, from out/chrome-root) and libc.so.6.
